name: Neon
description: Glass-tube signs on a brick wall at night, over a wet pavement that mirrors them. The word LIVE glows with the low notes, over a bar that brightens on each beat; a pair of joined notes glows with the middle; a star in a ring glows with the high notes; three arcs of sound light one after another as the music gets louder. Along the foot of the wall stand fourteen columns of short tubes, each column a part of the spectrum, lit as high as its part sounds. The high notes shake the picture in the puddles.
